We have been working nonstop to find a solution and as of last week, we have a working solution that it will last long-term. As for the models that allow us to use the main pages, if you noticed that we may have paused in the last week or so, it is due to us, making sure your accounts are completely secure and are not at risk, as we know how important they are. We also we’ve introduced a meta support team, that is able to help you regarding any issues with your account. Majority of issues will be covered in house, and any that will need a higher up rep, we will split that cost with you, if it’s something you want! I’m extremely excited for this to roll out, as just the testing alone in two weeks has generated over 400 million views across the Accounts.
